Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Shalini - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Isha - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Vimla - 69 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Kunal - 9 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Rishabh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Rishabh: "Mom, listen!"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Shalini: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Shalini stands near him.]

Rishabh: "So, here we are!"

[Rishabh sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Shalini: "One more time!"

[Rishabh mops the floor.]

Rishabh: "Okay, Mom."

[Rishabh irons his school shirt.]

Rishabh: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Night

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Shalini: "And then?"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Rishabh: "Oh wow!"

Scene 4: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Rishabh, look over here."

[Rishabh goes jogging in the park.]

Shalini: "Rishabh, look at this."

[Rishabh throws the ball to Mother.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Rishabh catches the ball.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

[Rishabh plays cricket in the park.]

Rishabh (excited): "I knew it!"

[Rishabh swings on the swing.]

Shalini: "That was fun!"

[Rishabh feeds the birds.]

Shalini: "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Shalini: "I really enjoyed today."
